name: BCC Grid Sampling
definition: Using a Body Centered Cartesian (BCC) lattice, the dual of the Face-Centered Cartesian (FCC) lattice, to store volume data with fewer samples than a Cubic Cartesian (CC) grid.
summary: BCC Grid Sampling uses a Body-Centered Cartesian lattice to store volume data with 29% fewer samples than cubic grids, requiring spherical filters to avoid aliasing.
